project.name: JLPT Vocab App
project.description: A free, self-built web app for studying JLPT N1-N5 vocabulary with flashcards, level filtering, and progress tracking

status_overview.vocabulary_data: partial — 437 words hand-written, need full 8000-word dataset

todos.title: Import full N1-N5 vocabulary dataset (~8000 words)
todos.details: Download n1.csv ~ n5.csv from github.com/jamsinclair/open-anki-jlpt-decks, upload to Claude, generate SQL and import into Supabase `words` table. Current 437 hand-written words are placeholder only.
blockers: Need user to download CSV files manually due to network restrictions

todos.title: Enable Supabase Auth
todos.details: Enable Email/Password auth in Supabase dashboard. Optionally add Google OAuth. The `progress` table RLS is already set up to use auth.uid().
subtasks: Enable auth provider in Supabase dashboard
Configure redirect URLs for local dev and Vercel

todos.title: Scaffold React project
todos.details: Init with Vite, install Tailwind CSS, install @supabase/supabase-js. Set up folder structure and env vars for Supabase URL + anon key.
subtasks: Set up .env with VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY

todos.title: Auth pages: Login / Register
todos.details: Simple login and register forms using Supabase Auth JS SDK. Protect app routes — redirect to login if not authenticated.

todos.title: Flashcard core feature
todos.details: The main study screen. Shows one word at a time as a flip card. User sees the word, flips to see reading + meaning, then marks 正解 or 不正解. Syncs result to `progress` table.
subtasks: FlashCard component with CSS flip animation
Fetch words from Supabase by level
On answer: upsert into `progress` (correct_count / wrong_count, status)

todos.title: Progress / Stats page
todos.details: Dashboard showing learning progress. Per-level breakdown of new / learning / known words. Bar or donut chart for visual feedback.
subtasks: Query progress table aggregated by level and status
Overall stats: total words seen, known rate, streak

todos.title: Word list / Browse mode
todos.details: Optional screen to browse all words by level, searchable by kanji or reading. Useful for quick lookup.
subtasks: Paginated word list with level filter
Search bar (client-side filter or Supabase ilike query)

todos.title: SRS (Spaced Repetition) — optional upgrade
todos.details: Implement SM-2 algorithm (same as Anki) to schedule next_review_at based on answer quality. Add a 'Due for review today' queue on home screen.
subtasks: Home screen: show due count per level

todos.title: Deploy frontend to Vercel
todos.details: Connect GitHub repo to Vercel. Set environment variables. PWA config optional (add manifest.json + service worker so users can add to phone home screen).
subtasks: Set VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in Vercel env vars
Optional: add vite-plugin-pwa for mobile home screen support

words.note: Placeholder data only. Needs full dataset import (todo #1).

progress.rls: user can only read/write own rows

immediate_next_steps: Download n1~n5 CSV from jamsinclair/open-anki-jlpt-decks and send to Claude → import full vocab data
Run: npm create vite@latest to scaffold the React project
Get Supabase anon key from dashboard → set up env vars
